sentences.zh: 但在法律上，这对他到底有什么改变？

sentences.en: The first thought that we had when we saw this document today was, what did Donald Trump say in the responses he gave to Mueller earlier this month?
sentences.zh: 我们今天看到这份文件时的第一个想法是，唐纳德·特朗普在本月早些时候对穆勒的回应中说了什么？

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: So two weeks ago, Donald Trump, after nearly a year of negotiating about an interview with investigators,
sentences.zh: 因此，两周前，唐纳德·特朗普在经过近一年的关于接受调查人员采访的谈判后，

sentences.en: sent in written responses to Robert Mueller.
sentences.zh: 向罗伯特·穆勒提交了书面答复。

sentences.en: How many were there?
sentences.zh: 有多少个？

sentences.en: Well, we don't know how many there were.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们不知道有多少个。

sentences.en: What we do know from our own reporting earlier this year, where we got the list of 49 questions that Mueller wanted to ask the president,
sentences.zh: 我们从今年早些时候的报道中确实知道的是，我们得到了穆勒想要问总统的49个问题的清单，

sentences.en: is that one of them was just about this issue.
sentences.zh: 其中一个问题正是关于这个问题的。

sentences.en: What interaction and communication did you have with Michael Cohen, Felix Sater, and others,
sentences.zh: 在竞选期间，你与迈克尔·科恩、菲利克斯·萨特及其他人（

sentences.en: including foreign nationals, regarding real estate developments in Russia during the period of the campaign?
sentences.zh: 包括外国国民）就俄罗斯的房地产开发有哪些互动和沟通？

sentences.en: Remind me who Felix Sater is.
sentences.zh: 提醒我一下，菲利克斯·萨特是谁？

sentences.en: Felix Sater was a Russian-born American businessman who was working with Michael Cohen and the Trump Organization on this project and had helped them with Trump's Soho,
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯·萨特是一位出生于俄罗斯的美国商人，他曾与迈克尔·科恩和特朗普集团合作开展该项目，并曾协助他们处理特朗普苏荷项目，

sentences.en: a building he had built several years ago.
sentences.zh: 这是他几年前建造的一栋大楼。

sentences.en: So your first thought on Thursday morning was, did the president answer that question?
sentences.zh: 所以你周四早上的第一想法是，总统回答那个问题了吗？

sentences.en: And if he did, did he answer it truthfully?
sentences.zh: 如果回答了，他回答得诚实吗？

sentences.en: The first thing I did was go into my email where I knew I had the exact text of the questions
sentences.zh: 我做的第一件事就是打开邮箱，我知道那里存着今年早些时候给特朗普律师的那些问题原文

sentences.en: that were given to Trump's lawyers earlier this year that Mueller wanted to ask and found this.
sentences.zh: 那是穆勒想要询问的，我找到了这些。

sentences.en: And then I called Maggie and said, we got to figure out what Trump said in his responses.
sentences.zh: 然后我打电话给玛吉说，我们得弄清楚特朗普在回应中说了什么。

sentences.en: We wanted to know whether the president had been truthful in his statements to Mueller,
sentences.zh: 我们想知道总统对穆勒的陈述是否诚实，

sentences.en: because if he hadn't, that would be perjury and would open him up to a whole new set of accusations that he broke the law.
sentences.zh: 因为如果不够诚实，这就构成伪证，并会引发一系列触犯法律的新指控。

sentences.en: And that's what we spent the morning trying to figure out.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们一上午都在试图弄清楚的事情。

sentences.en: So what did you and Maggie Hammerman find out?
sentences.zh: 那么你和玛吉·哈默曼发现了什么？

sentences.en: Did the president answer this question and did he answer it truthfully?
sentences.zh: 总统回答了这个问题吗，他回答得诚实吗？

sentences.en: After a series of phone calls with the president's lawyer, Rudy Giuliani told us on the record that the president's responses lined up with what Cohen had said in court.
sentences.zh: 在与总统律师进行了一系列电话沟通后，鲁迪·朱利安尼在公开场合告诉我们，总统的回应与科恩在法庭上的说法一致。

sentences.en: That the president, in his responses to Mueller, said he knew about the deal and had discussed it with Cohen.
sentences.zh: 总统在对穆勒的回应中表示，他知道这笔交易，并曾与科恩讨论过。

sentences.en: Did he say when he had discussed it?
sentences.zh: 他说是什么时候讨论的吗？

sentences.en: Giuliani said there was nothing in the questions that was specific to the timing and the president hadn't offered anything on that.
sentences.zh: 朱利安尼说，问题中没有任何关于具体时间的内容，总统也没有主动提供这方面的信息。

sentences.en: So Giuliani is saying that the president did not lie about this?
sentences.zh: 所以朱利安尼的意思是，总统在这个问题上没有撒谎？

sentences.en: Saying the president's fine.
sentences.zh: 意思是总统没问题。

sentences.en: So in admitting that he did talk to Michael Cohen about the Moscow project in the middle of his presidential campaign, what has he told us about himself?
sentences.zh: 那么在承认他在总统竞选期间确实与迈克尔·科恩谈过莫斯科项目时，他向我们透露了关于他自己的什么信息？

sentences.en: If Giuliani was being truthful, he's saying that the president is acknowledging that he knew that his associates
sentences.zh: 如果朱利安尼说的是实话，那就是说总统承认他知道自己的那些

sentences.en: who worked for him were trying to do a deal with the Russian government during the presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 为他工作的同僚在总统竞选期间试图与俄罗斯政府达成一笔交易。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I don't often like it when people compare him to other candidates.
sentences.zh: 而且我通常不喜欢人们把他和其他候选人作比较。

sentences.en: But to think about a Barack Obama or a John McCain running for president and at the same time having their fixers negotiating with a foreign adversary for a business deal,
sentences.zh: 但试想一下，如果巴拉克·奥巴马或约翰·麦凯恩竞选总统，同时他们的心腹却在与外国对手为一笔生意进行谈判，

sentences.en: I think that a disclosure like that would be outrageous and ground-shaking.
sentences.zh: 我认为这样的披露将是令人发指且震撼人心的。

sentences.en: And while today's development is a significant story, it may only be one of many that have come along the way.
sentences.zh: 虽然今天的事态发展是一个重大新闻，但它可能只是这一过程中众多事件之一。

sentences.en: And we often lose sight of that.
sentences.zh: 而我们经常忽视这一点。

sentences.en: Just how unusual it is to have a president do the kinds of things that he has done.
sentences.zh: 那就是让一位总统做出他所做的那种事是多么不同寻常。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think if any other candidate had done this, this is like, you know, first or second paragraph of the obituary.
sentences.zh: 我想如果换作任何其他候选人做了这件事，这就像是讣告的第一段或第二段了。

sentences.en: This may not even stick to Trump.
sentences.zh: 这甚至可能不会对特朗普造成负面影响。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Mike, what does Cohen's admission to the special counsel that he has lied about all this tell us about Mueller's strategy when it comes to the original investigation into Russia?
sentences.zh: 迈克，科恩向特别检察官承认他在这一切上撒了谎，这向我们说明了穆勒在最初的通俄调查中采取了什么策略？

sentences.en: We know that Cohen has gone in for dozens of hours to meet with Mueller's team.
sentences.zh: 我们知道科恩花了数十个小时与穆勒的团队会面。

sentences.en: He's testified before a grand jury.
sentences.zh: 他在大陪审团面前作证。

sentences.en: And what we're learning today is that Mueller's team is willing to accept a plea deal from Cohen, even though they know he lied before, in that they trust what he's saying now.
sentences.zh: 而我们今天了解到的是，穆勒的团队愿意接受科恩的认罪协议，尽管他们知道他以前撒过谎，但他们信任他现在所说的话。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Okay, Mueller's team would say, we know Michael Cohen was a liar and didn't tell the truth to Congress, but that's when he was working for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 好吧，穆勒的团队会说，我们知道迈克尔·科恩是个骗子，对国会没说实话，但那是他在为唐纳德·特朗普工作的时候。

sentences.en: Now, he's working for us, and he's trying to prove to us that he can be helpful because he doesn't want to go to prison for that long.
sentences.zh: 现在，他为我们工作，他正试图向我们证明他能提供帮助，因为他不想在监狱里待太久。

sentences.en: And he wants us to go to a judge and say, hey, be lenient on Michael Cohen.
sentences.zh: 他希望我们去找法官说，嘿，对迈克尔·科恩宽大处理吧。

sentences.en: He's been helpful.
sentences.zh: 他提供了帮助。

sentences.en: We've also investigated what Michael Cohen's been telling us, and we think he's being truthful.
sentences.zh: 我们也调查了迈克尔·科恩告诉我们的话，我们认为他说的是实话。

sentences.en: And is that the plan, that Mueller will advocate for a lighter sentence for Michael Cohen?
sentences.zh: 这就是计划吗，即穆勒会为主张减轻迈克尔·科恩的刑罚而辩护？

sentences.en: I don't think Cohen would be doing this today if he didn't think there was a damn good possibility that Mueller would do that.
sentences.zh: 我不认为科恩今天会这么做，除非他认为穆勒会这么做有极大的可能。

sentences.en: We're back in the same situation that we were in with Manafort.
sentences.zh: 我们又回到了当初对待马纳福特的同一处境中。

sentences.en: Paul Manafort has essentially two people who decide his fate.
sentences.zh: 保罗·马纳福特基本上有两个人来决定他的命运。

sentences.en: Bob Mueller, who could go to a judge and say, give him a shorter sentence.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·穆勒，他可以去找法官说，判他轻一点。

sentences.en: Or Donald Trump, who could pardon him.
sentences.zh: 或者唐纳德·特朗普，他可以赦免他。

sentences.en: Michael Cohen has already turned on Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩已经背叛了唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Donald Trump has already called Michael Cohen a rat.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普已经骂迈克尔·科恩是告密者。

sentences.en: What he's trying to do, because he's a weak person and not a very smart person, what he's trying to do is end, and it's very simple, he's got himself a big prison sentence.
sentences.zh: 他现在试图做的，由于他是个软弱且不太聪明的人，他试图做的是结束这一切，其实很简单，他自己背负着一块沉重的刑期。

sentences.en: So the only person who can help Michael Cohen at this point is Bob Mueller and other senior
sentences.zh: 所以目前唯一能帮到迈克尔·科恩的人是鲍勃·穆勒和其他高级

sentences.en: Justice Department officials.
sentences.zh: 司法部官员。

sentences.en: Michael Cohen is lying, and he's trying to get a reduced sentence for things that have nothing to do with me.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩在撒谎，他试图为那些与我毫无关系的事情争取减刑。

sentences.en: So unlike Paul Manafort, who just a couple of days ago, you said, may very much be angling for a pardon.
sentences.zh: 因此，与保罗·马纳福特不同，就在几天前，你说他很可能在极力争取总统特赦。

sentences.en: Michael Cohen has given up on that possibility.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩已经放弃了这种可能性。

sentences.en: That's never going to happen.
sentences.zh: 那绝不可能发生。

sentences.en: He appears to have taken a completely different path and tried to embrace the government as much as possible as his only way of saving himself.
sentences.zh: 他似乎走了一条完全不同的道路，并尽可能地向政府靠拢，以此作为自救的唯一途径。

sentences.en: Michael Cohen's walking into court today saying, I'm working for Bob Mueller's team.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩今天走进法庭说，我在为鲍勃·穆勒的团队工作。

sentences.en: So Cohen is fully cooperating in the special counsel investigation in a way that we didn't fully understand before Thursday.
sentences.zh: 所以科恩正在以一种我们在周四之前没有完全理解的方式全力配合特别检察官的调查。

sentences.en: And today marks the first time that we kind of fully understand that everything that Cohen knows, Robert Mueller probably now knows too.
sentences.zh: 而今天标志着我们首次在某种程度上完全理解了科恩所知道的一切，罗伯特·穆勒现在可能也知道了。

sentences.en: We're not seeing this deal today like this if Mueller thought that Cohen was not helpful and not telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 如果穆勒认为科恩没有帮助且没有说实话，我们今天就不会看到这样的协议。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 迈克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Even if he was right, it doesn't matter because I was allowed to do whatever I wanted during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 即使他是对的，也无所谓，因为在竞选期间我被允许做任何我想做的事。

sentences.en: I was running my business, a lot of different things during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 我在竞选期间经营着我的生意，处理着许多不同的事情。

sentences.en: So very simple.
sentences.zh: 所以非常简单。

sentences.en: Or thanks for visiting us.
sentences.zh: 或者谢谢你来看望我们。

sentences.en: It's really, it's actually, what's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这真的，实际上，有趣的地方在于。

sentences.en: We didn't address it in the whole thing that we were face to face.
sentences.zh: 我们在面对面的整个过程中都没有谈到这一点。

sentences.en: What's interesting about watching you in person, and I wonder if this would happen in my absence, is how much hand gesturing you do.
sentences.zh: 面对面观察你时有趣的一点是，我不知道在我不在的时候会不会也这样，那就是你做了多少手势。

sentences.en: Like, there's a lot of physicality to the interview, and I wonder if you, would you do that if I weren't here?
sentences.zh: 比如，采访中有很大的肢体语言，我想知道如果你不在的话，你还会那样做吗？

sentences.en: Probably 33% less.
sentences.zh: 大概少百分之三十三吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能查阅所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: I probably will be meeting with President Putin.
sentences.zh: 我可能会与普京总统会面。

sentences.en: We haven't terminated that meeting.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有取消那次会面。

sentences.en: I was thinking about it, but we haven't.
sentences.zh: 我考虑过，但我们还没取消。

sentences.en: They'd like to have it.
sentences.zh: 他们想开会。

sentences.en: I think it's a very good time to have the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在是举行会面的绝佳时机。

sentences.en: On Thursday, President Trump abruptly canceled a one-on-one meeting with Russian President
sentences.zh: 周四，特朗普总统突然取消了原定于周六在阿根廷与俄罗斯总统

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin, scheduled for Saturday in Argentina, just hours after both countries had confirmed it.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京举行的一对一会谈，就在两国刚刚确认该会面几小时后。

sentences.en: In explaining the cancellation, the White House cited an unresolved naval standoff between
sentences.zh: 在解释取消原因时，白宫提到了俄罗斯与乌克兰之间

sentences.en: Russia and Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 尚未解决的海上对峙。

sentences.en: But the decision came shortly after Michael Cohen pleaded guilty to lying to Congress, suggesting that the president was seeking to avoid meeting with Putin amid embarrassing
sentences.zh: 但这一决定是在迈克尔·科恩承认对国会撒谎后不久做出的，这表明总统正试图在关于其与俄罗斯关系的尴尬

sentences.en: revelations about his ties to Russia.
sentences.zh: 爆料中避免与普京会面。

sentences.en: Russia said it had only learned of the cancellation after reading about it on the president's Twitter account.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯表示，他们是在阅读了总统的推特账号后才得知会面取消的。

sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 我们周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时甚至令人兴奋的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》播客中，我和萨拉·科尼格将为你讲述那些试图维持影响力却最终失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
